result: At pinned rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, RequestContext<RoleServer>::protocol_version reads current request metadata first and falls back to peer_info.protocol_version only when request metadata yields None. RequestContext<RoleServer>::client_capabilities returns only current request metadata when request metadata is required, with no peer_info fallback; for legacy sessions it reads request metadata first and then falls back to peer_info.capabilities. This resolves the accessor-layer precedence/fallback child: per-request protocolVersion metadata has precedence over initialized peer state, and per-request clientCapabilities has exclusive accessor authority in request-metadata-required sessions. The accessor bodies contain no equality/consistency comparison against peer_info, but this does not establish that no such check exists elsewhere before dispatch.
